limits: 64 synthetic queries on 27 fixture notes; no real vault and no relevance judgments beyond the fixture labels.
The tests.yml options use the lexical backend, which ignores the channel; effects appear only with --backend bm25 or hybrid.
Bigrams are not morphology: unrelated overlaps (for example the shared bigram 복구 in 실패복구 and 삼나무복구, or 확인 in 경보확인 and 확인한다) add candidates and can lower precision.

The bigram view changes BM25 length normalization, so it can reorder notes for English-only terms too; in en-spacing-01 and ko-spacing-01 (bm25, expansion on) the two views ranked the procedure note and its overview 1/2 and 2/1, the RRF sums tied (1/61 + 1/62) and the existing path tie-break put the overview first.
Single-syllable spacing queries (격 리 절 차) stay unigrams and do not match bigram tokens.
Evidence lines follow the existing BM25 passage rule with bigram tokens, so a frontmatter aliases line can be cited.
Measured on one Windows 11 machine with Python 3.12.10; elapsed times are machine-specific observations.
